code_hints: If landing on homepage (/en-gb/), treat as non-PLP and immediately navigate to the first start_urls entry.
Implement a soft-wait for cookie banner: query #onetrust-accept-btn-handler and click if present before any navigation.
If a store/locale modal appears, try buttons containing text 'Continue' or 'Go to site' before proceeding.
PLP readiness: wait for [data-cmp-is='mo-product-card'] or a grid of links ending with .html under product list; then collect product-card anchors for PDP.
Pagination: SFCC pages commonly use start and sz query params; preserve them and iterate start by current page size (e.g., sz or inferred item count).
On PDP, if CSS price selector fails, fall back to parsing application/ld+json for Product->offers->price and name.
rationale: The failure occurred because the crawler opened the Moncler homepage rather than a PLP, so no product tiles appeared. Prioritizing configuration, we force entry to stable PLP URLs under en-gb and add lightweight pre-actions for the OneTrust cookie banner and potential store modal. URL rules normalize locale to en-gb, avoid editorial/brand domains, and keep only pagination-relevant params. This should yield product tiles without changing core selectors.
